intro.fr: Library of Babel se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Library of Babel can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Tegridy Made Games sort Library of Babel en 2026.
text.en: Tegridy Made Games releases Library of Babel in 2026.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub YarRuin/LOBAP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Library of Babel.
text.en: The GitHub repository YarRuin/LOBAP, home of the Library of Babel APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 0.3.5b, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (3 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.3.5b is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (3 versions released).

text.fr: Library of Babel figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Library of Babel is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
